**Fujifilm‑X™ official compatibility (single‑digit X‑T models released before 2019)**  
The following **Toshiba** and **SanDisk** SD‑card models have been explicitly verified by the Fujifilm‑X support site to work with **every** single‑digit X‑T camera (X‑T1, X‑T2, X‑T3).  

| Size (GB) | Brand     | Model Number |
|-----------|-----------|--------------|
| 16        | Toshiba   | **SDXU‑B016G** |
| 16        | SanDisk   | **SDSDXPB‑016G** |
| 32        | Toshiba   | **SDXU‑B032G** |
| 32        | SanDisk   | **SDSDXPB‑032G** |
| 64        | Toshiba   | **SDXU‑B064G** |
| 64        | SanDisk   | **SDSDXPB‑064G** |

**Key points**

* These cards are the only Toshiba and SanDisk models that Fujifilm has listed on the compatibility pages for **all three cameras (X‑T1, X‑T2, X‑T3)**.  
* Each camera accepts SD SDHC / SDXC cards with UHS‑I/II bus speeds; the listed models are UHS‑II and meet the required speed classes (U3/V60/V90) for 4 K video.  
* While other cards may also work, these six models are the officially tested and guaranteed options for full cross‑model compatibility.
